summary: Full-stack review of the reworked Pomario / Frutteto Agro agronomic engine. Backend: rewrote the outdated backend_test.py to cover the NEW API surface (25+ endpoints across auth, reference, plants+BBCH auto-phases, products, treatments+supersede, engine cycle, recommendations, alerts, weather demo, irrigation, config, AI phases). All 27 pytest tests PASS (100%). Frontend: end-to-end flow (fresh register → empty state → add Melo → 14 pomacee phases → set Fioritura → add rame product → add treatment → run engine cycle → verify recs/alerts/weather/settings → admin login) all work. Ecowitt demo weather returns valid data. AI phase regeneration (Claude Sonnet) returns 12+ phases. Engine correctly generates a pending recommendation on a risky phase without coverage, and skips generation once a compatible treatment provides coverage — verified in pytest test_full_cycle_creates_recommendation.

design_issues.screen: All dashboard pages with success toast
issues: Sonner toasts render in the top-right corner and visually overlap the primary top-right action button ('Aggiungi pianta', 'Aggiungi prodotto', 'Aggiungi trattamento'). During the ~4s toast lifetime the button remains clickable in DOM but the toast covers it — users perceive it as blocked. Consider top-left or bottom-center toast position, or reduce toast duration for success events.
Applied-at field uses native browser <input type='date'> instead of the available shadcn Calendar component (inconsistent with the rest of the design language).
Carried over from iteration_2: logout lands on /accedi instead of the landing page /. LOW priority UX polish.

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: Move Sonner toast position (e.g. bottom-center) so success toasts do not visually overlap top-right action buttons.
OPTIONAL/LOW: Replace native date input in TreatmentForm with shadcn Calendar for design consistency.
OPTIONAL/LOW: Consider polishing logout navigation to land on '/' (from iteration_2).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: get_current_user handles both httpOnly cookie and Authorization: Bearer — correct dual-auth fallback for the preview environment.

server.py: Plant creation atomically inserts plant + full BBCH phases + sets first phase as current — good UX, though not wrapped in a transaction (Mongo Motor doesn't require it unless multi-doc atomicity is critical).
server.py: register/login return 'token' in body AND set httpOnly cookie — verified in tests.
server.py: /api/config uses string values in DEFAULT_CONFIG (e.g. '15' not 15.0). engine.py always casts via float() — safe but subtle. Consider migrating to typed values in future.
engine.py: _oid() returns a static 'zero' ObjectId on parse error, which then silently returns None from find_one. Not risky in the current flow (IDs are always internal) but worth flagging.
engine.py: generate_phase_recommendations correctly (a) checks coverage first, (b) picks compatible-in-stock product, (c) falls back to advisory rec with product_id=None — matches spec.
engine.py: run_cycle blocks recommendation generation while is_raining=true — creates a single 'rain_block' info alert (anti-spam dedup works). ✔
phases.py: SPECIES_LIST covers 14 species with proper template mapping including keyword-based fallback in template_for_species. ✔
Frontend TreatmentForm: does not display any inline hint about the disabled 'Aggiungi trattamento' button when plants OR products are empty — user has to guess. Consider a tooltip.
Frontend Products.jsx: PUT /products includes ALL fields (spread of p) when toggling stock, which is correct but wasteful. Consider a dedicated PATCH endpoint.
Frontend AI: /plants/{id}/generate-phases toast on error is generic ('Generazione AI non riuscita'); backend returns 502 detail — surface it for debugging.
Backend uses os.environ.get(...) without default for REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL check in tests (I passed it via env in the test run). server.py itself hard-fails on missing MONGO_URL/DB_NAME — good.
No brute-force lockout — unchanged from prior iteration, not required by this review request.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (REWRITTEN to cover the new agronomic engine API: 27 pytests, all passing)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows verified: register + trial, empty-state, add plant with auto-BBCH, set phase, add product, add treatment, run cycle, recs/alerts/weather/settings, admin login)

test_credentials: Admin: admin@frutteto.it / Frutteto2026! — verified. Fresh users registered via UI + API for empty-state tests.
seed_data_creation: None. Verified fresh users start with 0 plants and 0 products (vergine). Test data prefixed with 'TEST_' / 'test_ui_' for identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file is now aligned with the current agronomic-engine API. To run: `cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<preview_url> pytest tests/backend_test.py -v`. The rewritten suite creates several TEST_* users/plants/products (soft-delete or scoped to user, not garbage-collected). Engine cycle test is randomness-tolerant: demo weather occasionally 'rains' — the test branches on `is_raining` and asserts the rain-block alert path instead of a recommendation. AI phase regeneration test may take up to 60s (Claude Sonnet). Frontend: use JS click (`element.click()`) to bypass the Sonner top-right toast which visually overlaps top-right action buttons for ~4s after a success. Treatment form requires selecting a plant AND a product from dropdowns before saving.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — this iteration was feature verification, not a bug fix. All requested flows (auth, empty vergine state, plants+BBCH auto-phases, products, treatments, engine cycle, recs, alerts, weather, config, AI phases) work as specified. Only cosmetic design issues surfaced (toast overlap on primary CTA, native date picker, logout redirect UX).
